items.rationale: Section 5.2.6(b) covers the inspection to establish the cause and extent of the loss. The gross estimate of €524 for one flat-rate assessment is below the separate €3,000 cap.
Section 5.2.6(a) covers indoor leak location. The estimated €500 for the detection work plus €150 for the separately itemised technician time is below their shared €1,000 cap.

Section 5.2.6(a) expressly covers the leak-location technician's on-site time, and the flat-rate description does not state that it includes this labour. The invoiced 2.5 hours at €60 gross per hour total €150, within the shared cap.
Section 5.2.6(c) permits one vehicle charge per contractor per invoice. The single invoiced charge is estimated at €79 gross, below the €70 net cap (€83.30 gross at 19% VAT).

items.description: Repair of actively leaking copper joints
items.rationale: Section 2.4.3(a) treats ageing-related leakage as fracture damage for the sections verified to be leaking, and §9.1.1 does not treat ordinary ageing alone as a breach. The single flat rate to seal or renew both failed joints is estimated at €400 gross; the €500 deductible applies once to the event, not separately to this line.

items.description: Precautionary replacement of non-leaking copper run
items.rationale: Sections 2.4.3(a) and 7.1.5 exclude replacement of sections not shown to be leaking. The amount is a conditional gross estimate for the one flat-rate line, not a recommended payment.
Section 7.1.9 limits reinstatement to the pre-loss specification, so the premium upgrade difference is excluded. The amount is a conditional estimate for the single surcharge only.

Section 5.2.6(c) allows the plumber's single vehicle charge because the visit included covered joint repairs and was billed by a different contractor on a separate invoice. The €79 gross estimate is below the €83.30 gross cap.
